next_step: POC perf results review + security checklist sign-off
notes:
Summary: global insurance claims + policy search use-case. Need high-quality cross-lingual recall for 12 target languages (en, fr, de, es, it, pt, nl, sv, pl, ru, zh, ja). Primary goal is RAG: dense retrieval via embeddings + lightweight reranker to push precision on top-k. Indexing scale: ~120M documents (policies, claims notes, legal memos).

Key requirements / constraints:
- Per-language recall targets: recall@100 >= 0.85 for en/fr/de, >= 0.70 for low-resource languages (pl, sv) initially. Want per-language dashboards.
- Latency: initial SLO p95 end-to-end query (retrieve + rerank) <= 350ms for EU region for top-10 results; budget for dedicated racks if needed.
- Cost sensitivity: tight unit-economics; target avg cost/query (hosted) <$0.04 with batching + caching; willing to trade some latency for cost on background analytics.
- Model preferences: evaluating cross-lingual sentence embeddings vs per-language fine-tuned encoders. Interested in Redwood recommendations for quantized model variants for reranking to lower GPU cost.
- Routing/fallback: need automatic fallback to lower-cost model group when capacity/backpressure; fallback must preserve language-specific recall profiles.
- Security: VPC/private control plane preferred; data residency in EU; audit logging + KMS. SOC2/ISO expected.

Timeline & recent activity:
- 2025-10-05: inbound from tech blog, AE outreach (Maya) opened account.
- 2025-11-12: discovery call; provided initial dataset sizing (50M docs). action: prep POC plan. (ff_20251112_3011)
- 2025-12-04: architecture deep-dive with infra team; SE Oliver in attendance. notes: prefer VPC + dedicated pool for latency predictability.
- 2026-01-12: kickoff POC for embeddings + rerank (seed 2M docs per shard). (ff_20260112_7810)
- 2026-02-03: interim POC demo — retrieval recall good on en/fr; low-resource languages lagging. Action items: test per-language embedding fine-tune vs multilingual baseline. (ff_20260203_9462)
- 2026-02-20: security questionnaire returned; legal has additional questions on residency and retention.

Technical notes from POC so far:
- Using multilingual transformer base (sentence-transformers-like). Embedding dim 768. Observed: retrieval latency (kNN on 2M shard) ~50ms; reranker (cross-encoder) p95 ~220ms on g4-like instance — combined ~270ms. Scaling concern: cross-encoder rerank at 1000 qps would need >8 GPUs unless we move to approximate rerank + candidate re-scoring.
- Indexing: ingestion pipeline needs to support language tags + per-lang analyzers. They plan nightly full reindex for policy changes (~500k docs/day).
- Precision tuning: want per-language thresholds and eval sets; Redwood Optimize suggested prompt/quantization tradeoffs.

Stakeholder quotes / paraphrases:
- "We need parity in results quality across our EU languages — customers notice localized misses." — Head of Search
- "Budget team will only greenlight dedicated pool if we can show 30% cost savings vs current managed API at scale." — Procurement

Next steps (short):
- Run per-language embedding fine-tune A/B (Oliver).
- Provide cost model for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private at 100M+ index (Maya).
- Security: respond to two residency questions and provide SOC2 artifacts (Nia to coordinate).

POC success criteria (customer defined):
- Recall@100 delta vs baseline >= +0.08 for at least 8/12 languages.
- End-to-end p95 <= 350ms for top-10 in EU region at demo load (50 qps).
- Estimated cost/query <= $0.04 or clear Dedicated plan showing ROI within 9 months.

Notes style: shorthand, action-oriented. See linked drive docs for POC slides and security FAQ.
